summary: Prepared and validated the homelab MetaMCP image, Tempo embedded MCP, and read-only Kubernetes identity/RBAC. Live in-cluster MetaMCP discovery works for the existing endpoint, but requested server registration and public OAuth cannot safely complete without an authorized token source and public hostname/AuthentiK exposure decision.
validation: MetaMCP latest stable GitHub release verified as v2.4.22; chart renders its immutable digest.
helm lint passed for charts/metamcp and observability.
MetaMCP server-side dry-run passed with explicit homelab kubeconfig/context.
Rendered Kubernetes ClusterRole contains only get/list/watch and no secrets resource.
In-cluster OAuth metadata returned 200; temporary DCR registration returned 201 and was removed.
Streamable HTTP initialize and tools/list succeeded; 65 tools were visible.
Existing Grafana__list_loki_label_names failed because its Grafana URL remains the unresolvable Codicarium host.
blockers: Choose/authorize a canonical public HTTPS MetaMCP hostname and whether to expose a split public ingress; current hosts are VPN/private and workstation DNS currently fails.
Make Authentik reachable at a public-compatible hostname and register the exact MetaMCP OIDC callback for the chosen APP_URL.
Provide or identify the authorized Bitwarden/source path for the existing GitHub bearer token; do not extract or duplicate an unidentified secret.
Provide a fresh least-privilege homelab ArgoCD API token or authorize its creation and secret-store path.
Choose a verified Loki implementation: homelab Grafana MCP with a homelab Grafana token, or a separately built/published Loki MCP image; no verified direct Loki image is currently available.
next_action: After the hostname/AuthentiK and credential-source decisions are supplied, register the seven MCPs, enable the endpoint OAuth flag, roll out through GitOps, and run per-server discovery/tool/safe-call/target-isolation validation.
independent_lanes: MetaMCP chart/image and read-only Kubernetes identity

issues.title: Observability chart dry-run references missing grafana-test ServiceAccount
issues.details: Server-side dry-run of the existing observability chart is rejected because pod grafana-test references observability/grafana-test, which is absent. Helm lint and the Tempo MCP render still pass.
